matrix128.meaning: Maps homogeneous output-grid (x,y,z,1) to image pixel centers

code.meaning: Optional RAW frozen-AE encoding, before standardization

pairing: image and matrix128 must originate from the same crop; target provides supervision only
tensor_axes: D=z, H=y, W=x; projection vector uses (x,y,z,1)
mask5: Supervision/diagnostic only, never a generative inference input
